items.title: Highland Mountain Bike Park By interlock
items.detail: http://www.highlandmountain.com/ Highland Mountain Bike Park, located in Northfield, New Hampshire, USA, was founded in 2003. It bills itself as "America's Bike Park" and as a park 100% dedicated to mountain biking. However, its security lapses led to the compromise of customer and employee data, including contracts, and the leak of all accounting records and invoices. Ransomware group claim; not independently verified. The observation/publication date is not the attack date.

items.title: Assiniboine Dental Group By interlock
items.detail: https://www.assiniboinedentalgroup.com/ Assiniboine Dental Group is a private dental practice in Winnipeg, Manitoba, operating as a "trustee." It is required to securely store patients' personal health information in accordance with the province's Personal Health Information Protection Act (PHIA). However, due to negligence in security, dental records and payment information (patient names, contact information, treatment history, and insurance/financial transaction information) were compromised and are being offered to your attention. Ransomware group claim; not independently verified. The observation/publication date is not the attack date.

items.title: hitech group leaks By hyflock
items.detail: Hitech Group (HaiTai Group) Quick Info: Headquarters: Mumbai Founded: 1991, by Ashwin Dani (late, co-founder and former vice-chairman of Asian Paints) Type: Indian diversified business group with multiple companies under the "Hitech" brand, over 1000 employees, operating at 15 locations in India, also has a DSIR (Department of Scientific and Industrial Research) certified tech center Main Activities: Hard Plastic Packaging (core business, operated through Hitech Corporation Ltd.) — plastic jars, bottles, drums, industrial containers serving paint & coatings, personal care, construction, chemicals, lubricants, food & beverages, home care, etc. Specialty Chemicals Trading Personal Care Formulation Products Food & Nutrition Insurance Stock Info: Hitech Corporation Limited is listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange, code BSE: 526217, and is a subsidiary of Geetanjali Trading and Investments Private Limited Website: hitechgroup.com Financials: Around USD 63 million revenue, roughly 423 employees (third-party data, may be outdated) Also, there are several other companies in India called "Hitech / Hi-Tech," don’t mix them up: Company Location Business Hi-Tech (hitech.in) — equipment and engineering services for power and process industries in India since 1989 Hitech India Pvt Ltd (hitechconnector.com) Hyderabad, electrical/military connectors, 45 years old, supplier for India’s first nuclear submarine INS Arihant Hitech India (hitechindia.net) Mumbai, post-press printing equipment HiTech India (hitechindia.co.in) Coimbatore, UPVC/PVC door & window manufacturer and exporter Hitech India Equipments Pvt Ltd — founded in 1990, industrial equipment So, if you see a listed group in India doing plastic packaging, that’s Hitech Corporation Ltd (Mumbai, BSE 526217) Ransomware group claim; not independently verified. The observation/publication date is not the attack date.
